ideas.pitch: An automated local enumeration script tuned for beginner CTFs to quickly parse linpeas outputs and map privilege escalation vectors.
ideas.title: Auto-Pwn Companion for Boot2Root
ideas.why_it_could_win: Genuinely hard engineering applied to automation, saving crucial minutes during a tight 24-48 hour window.

ideas.title: FlagVault Local Manager
